free_tier.stated: 'Free usenet server' with 'no credit card required, a password will be emailed to you'. Includes NNTP access for a newsreader or downloader, and a web-to-usenet gateway for browser access.

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap is published; the unit of retrieval is a Usenet article, ~750 KB by convention, so a 1 TiB month is roughly 1.4 million article fetches
per_object_cap.notes: an article size is a protocol convention, not a vendor number

retention.stated: Not stated anywhere read. The site carries only the groups its members request: 'We only carry the newsgroups that our members have requested. To add a newsgroup, please email support.'

egress.terms: Nothing published about speed, volume or retention; the only number on the site is the connection count

interface_detail: NNTP over TLS on port 563; no HTTP or object API exists for the download path, so a user drives it through SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav
tooling: SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav over NNTP/TLS; any newsreader works because the protocol is the same everywhere, and no provider SDK is needed
chaining: Would stack as a zero-cost secondary for recent, popular binaries if it is alive; it cannot be a primary, because three connections and a member-requested group list cannot cover a workload.

limits.value: 3 connections free, up to 12 on a premium account

limits_note: Server settings published: host news.usenetmax.com, port 563, 3 connections free with the note that 'more than 3 rarely improves anything'. The bundled indexer is ikbin, an open-source binary indexer whose own FAQ says it is 'a demonstration and testing site' and that 'content may be cleared out rather unexpectedly if a beta goes south'.
binding_note: Three simultaneous connections is the ceiling and it is published; no volume or retention figure exists to bind instead. Three connections will not saturate a line, so throughput, not volume, is what a 50 GiB month runs into.

identity_cost.detail: An email address: 'no credit card required, a password will be emailed to you'. That is the whole gate as published.

reliability_note: A demo server attached to a demo indexer, with a group list that only covers what members ask for and a stated risk that content disappears when the beta misbehaves. Liveness is the open question: the page body came back from a search index with no HTTP status, and a direct fetch returned a 522.
confidence_note: The offer text was read from the live page body on 2026-10-23, but no HTTP status accompanied it and the direct fetch failed. Nothing was connected to, so neither the account flow nor the service's availability is established.

evidence.proved: 'Free usenet server'; 'NNTP access for newsreader or downloader'; 'Web to usenet gateway for browser access'; 'no credit card required a password will be emailed to you'
Host news.usenetmax.com, port 563, 'Connections: 3 (up to 12 for a premium account)'
the bundled indexer is ikbin, 'a demonstration and testing site'; 'Content may be cleared out rather unexpectedly if a beta goes south'

notes: The one lead that could clear the bar for nothing, and the one that could not be confirmed alive. A reader with a working network should try the signup before trusting it.
